title: Statement of No Loss and Mid-Term Package Changes, Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
## Statement of No Loss
A Statement of No Loss on a Named Non-Owner Policy term is taken only for a nonpayment cancellation being reinstated with a lapse or a renewal accepted after expiration. The named insured personally attests whether any accident, loss or claim occurred during the lapse period; the attestation is the named insured's own statement, recorded on a statement tied to the term. It covers the lapse from its first day through the signing date; when a loss is reported, the statement records no attestation of no loss and supports nothing.

| Statement records | Effect |
|---|---|
| no loss attested | supports the reinstatement with a lapse or late renewal it was taken for |
| a loss reported | supports nothing |

## Mid-term package changes
~~A mid-term package change takes effect on the requested date, never earlier, and is refused when it would leave an FR-44 Operator certificate backed by a package outside the package's FR-44 filing states.~~ This clause is **no longer in force** as written. Current basis: when a DUI-related FR-44 Operator certificate requirement of the named insured is recorded, an FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured whose status is requested, filed or rejected, while the term carries a package that does not accept a DUI or DWI conviction within 60 months, the term is realigned mid-term to Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50, the highest package that accepts such a conviction and lists both Florida and Virginia among its FR-44 states, provided the named insured's violation points do not exceed that package's new-business maximum of 12; its full-term premium is re-rated under the company's realignment rule and the change takes effect on the day it is made and never earlier; every other mid-term package change still takes effect on the requested date, never earlier, and is still refused when it would leave an FR-44 Operator certificate backed by a package outside the package's FR-44 filing states.

superseded_clauses: A mid-term package change takes effect on the requested date, never earlier, and is refused when it would leave an FR-44 Operator certificate backed by a package outside fr44_filing_states.
